findings.message: 11 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Barbearia em Gravatá, PE" above "Seu corte. Sua identidade."; "Agendar no AppBarber" above "Damião"; "Agendar no AppBarber" above "Eduardo"; "PROCEDIMENTO COM CERA" above "Kauã"; "PROCEDIMENTO COM CERA" above "Rafael"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 64 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): details.service-row 787px | details.service-row 787px | details.service-row 787px | details.service-row 787px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 4 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 2 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Cuidado." (screen 7, 38% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 7 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 8px at 390px. Widest offenders: h2 (+8px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).
